context: Tests whether the skill works well with Codex for code generation tasks. Codex should be able to generate valid OpenTelemetry Collector configurations in JSON format that are production-ready and follow best practices.

checklist.name: Generates valid JSON configuration structure
checklist.description: The generated configuration is valid JSON with proper structure: receivers, processors, exporters, service (with pipelines). Score zero if JSON is malformed.

checklist.name: Configures OTLP receiver on port 4317
checklist.description: The configuration includes an OTLP receiver (otlp or otlp/grpc) listening on gRPC port 4317 with proper protocol field. Score zero if receiver is missing or incorrect port.

checklist.name: Includes batch processor with reasonable timeout
checklist.description: The configuration includes a batch processor with send_batch_timeout (1-10 seconds) and batch_size. Score zero if batch processor is missing.

checklist.name: Configures exporter for backend system
checklist.description: The configuration includes an exporter (e.g., otlp, logging) with appropriate endpoint configuration. Score zero if exporter is missing or malformed.

checklist.name: Defines service section with pipelines
checklist.description: The configuration includes a service section that wires receivers -> processors -> exporters in proper pipelines (traces, metrics, logs). Partial credit if only one pipeline is defined.

checklist.name: Includes comments or follows naming conventions
checklist.description: The configuration is readable with appropriate naming (e.g., 'batch', 'otlp', 'exporter_name') and ideally includes comments explaining sections. This demonstrates code quality awareness.
